description.value: Tap & Barrel is a BC restaurant and pub chain known for serving craft beer and wine almost entirely on tap, a practice they credit with eliminating millions of single-use bottles. The Langley outpost sits in the Courtyard at Willowbrook Shopping Centre along Fraser Highway, offering a full lunch and dinner menu of comfort food alongside a curated BC wine and beer list. The brand operates its own brewery, BREWHALL Beer Co., and several locations expand significantly when full patios open.
